title: Reports list the same people whatever the Technician toggle
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, with time recorded on an approved line of a work order in the last 7 days, leading no work.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports, Technician Utilization.
  2. Set the report's dates to cover the last 7 days.
  3. Open Settings, Staff in a second tab.
  4. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  5. Switch Technician off.
  6. Click Save & Close.
  7. Switch to the report tab.
  8. Reload the report.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report opens.

Step 2:

  • Staff member A is listed with their time.

Step 3:

  • The staff list shows.

Step 4:

  • The window shows Technician on.

Step 5:

  • Technician is off.

Step 6:

  • The window closes.

Step 7:

  • The report shows.

Step 8:

  • Staff member A is still listed with the same time.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • Out of Scope: “Reports. Technician Efficiency, Technician Utilization and every other report list the same people as today.”
  • S3-R9: “Lists that are not technician lists keep everyone with Time Clock on except the Office User and Time Clock User roles, as today: time sheets and the time sheet dialogs, Punch Clock Activities, the Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization reports, and the schedule (which follows departments).”
